name: hypertask_attachments
does: Upload files to a ticket or one of its comments.
use_when: Use when an existing ticket or comment needs a file; create and update actions can also accept inline attachments.
do_not_use_when: Do not use to fetch arbitrary URLs or upload without a known target ticket.
parameters_and_caveats: action selects an operation; input contains only that operation’s documented fields. response_format defaults to concise for reads; detailed retains full fields. limit defaults to 20 (maximum 50) and offset defaults to 0 for bounded read results; use returned pagination or narrower filters. files contains upload objects with filename, content_type and exactly one of data (base64) or url, subject to existing request size limits. Partial upload failures include retry guidance; do not repeat a successful mutation.
